User.title: User
User.description: Represents a user of the Decimal Conquest game.

id.description: Unique identifier for the User entity.

countryId.description: Reference to the Country this user belongs to.

Country.title: Country
Country.description: Represents a country created by a user.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Country entity.

createdBy.description: The UID of the user who created the country.

LandTile.title: LandTile
LandTile.description: Represents a single land tile on the game map.

id.description: Unique identifier for the LandTile entity.

x.description: X-coordinate of the land tile on the map.

y.description: Y-coordinate of the land tile on the map.

ownerId.description: Reference to the User who owns this land tile. (Relationship: User 1:N LandTile)

ProblemAttempt.title: ProblemAttempt
ProblemAttempt.description: Represents a user's attempt at solving a math problem.

definition.description: Stores user profiles. Path-based ownership ensures only the user can modify their own profile.

params.description: The unique identifier of the user.
